observations.text: Project: RUPP Campus Navigation (Smart Building Mapping and Navigation System). Group 1. Topic: Using Graphs, Trees, and Hash Tables for campus navigation.
Three DSA layers: Graph (Dijkstra shortest path), Tree (BST/AVL for category filtering), Hash Table (O(1) building info lookup).
Team roles: Heng Hour (Leader/Integration), Heng Pengly (Graph), Yos Sak (Hash Table), Sem Vatanakpanha (Tree), Kimheng (UI/Tester).
OpenCode bootstrap is set up with skill symlinks, MCP servers (claude-mem + playwright), and cross-session memory via opencode-bootstrap repo.
